description: This file defines the HelpConfigService class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for retrieving help-related configuration values such as help processor class and help URL. It extends the ConfigService class and provides constants and methods for access to specific configuration keys.

classes.name: HelpConfigService
classes.description: A service class that manages help configuration settings, extending the core ConfigService and providing specific methods for accessing help processor class and URL.

methods.name: getHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Retrieves the help processor class name from configuration.

methods.name: getBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for help resources from configuration.
